name: Thomas2Go @ BambooHR (Lindon, UT) Build-Your-Own Grain Bowl (Grilled Chicken & White Rice)
whyItWorks: Build a custom flare-safe bowl: steamed white jasmine rice, warm grilled chicken breast cubes, and tender steamed zucchini/carrots with mild tamari sauce. Zero raw roughage or spicy dressings.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Select white rice base, double grilled chicken breast, steamed vegetables, and light olive oil or mild vinaigrette (avoid raw broccoli, beans, and spicy dressings).
watchOuts: Avoid raw cabbage, whole beans, and spicy sriracha dressings
